title: #032. Element-Indexed Machine Assignment
subtitle: Replace an N-by-M binary matrix with N integer variables, distinct(), and variable-indexed lookup at(costs[i], assignment[i]).

judge.m0: Output must be an object { assignment, totalCost }.
judge.m3: Machine {p0} is assigned to multiple jobs; each job must run on a distinct machine.
judge.m4: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed cost ({p1}).
judge.m5: Valid assignment, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
